name: School of Management Sciences, Indian Institute of Engineering Science and Technology, Shibpur

programs.name: Master of Business Administration (MBA), 2-Year Full-Time
programs.feeNote: Derived from the MBA Admission Brochure 2026-28 fee table: tuition Rs 1,00,000 per semester x 4 = 4,00,000 + other semester charges 11,500 x 4 = 46,000 + annual charges 7,600 x 2 = 15,200 + one-time charges 16,500 (includes refundable caution money, amount not split) = Rs 4,77,700. Amount payable at admission Rs 1,35,600. Hostel not included; fees subject to revision.
programs.intakeNote: Sanctioned seats per 2026-28 brochure: UR 25 (PwD 2), OBC-NCL 16 (PwD 1), SC 9, ST 4, EWS 6 = 60.
programs.placementNote: No placement statistics published in the brochure (recruiter list only).

selectionProcess.name: Screening of eligible applicants on academic record
selectionProcess.detail: Bachelor's with minimum 60% (CGPA 6.5) UR/OBC-NCL/EWS, 55% (CGPA 6.0) SC/ST/PwD, plus a valid MAT/CMAT/CAT/XAT/GMAT score.

selectionProcess.name: Interview (offline on campus or online) and final merit
selectionProcess.weightage: Academic performance from Class 10 onwards 50%, Interview 50%
selectionProcess.detail: Preference to consistently good academic records.

selectionWeightage.note: Two-tier selection for MBA 2026-28 after initial screening.

keyDates.notes: MBA 2026-28 cycle (already over): application deadline 30 Mar 2026; interview shortlist 2 Apr 2026; interview 8 Apr 2026; final list 17 Apr 2026. 2027-29 dates not yet published. Application fee Rs 1,500 (Rs 1,000 SC/ST/PwD).

nirf.note: Not in NIRF 2025 Management ranks 1-100; 101-125 band not checked
